sections.title: 📋  OP SIGNUPS
sections.body:
> Officers post an op with `/op-create`, everyone else signs up with `/op-join <id>`.
> 
> `/op-join <id>` — put yourself on the roster
> `/op-leave <id>` — drop off it
> `!op roster <id>` — see who's coming
> `!op list` — recent ops and their IDs

If the op has a real date and time set, you'll get pinged **30 minutes before it starts**.

sections.title: ⭐  PERFORMANCE RATINGS
sections.body:
> `/rate @member <1-5> [note]` — rate someone after an op
> `/rating-history @member` — their average score and recent feedback

Ratings are how we track who's ready for more responsibility. Leave a note — a score with no reason helps nobody.

sections.title: 🪪  YOUR PROFILE
sections.body:
> `/roblox <username>` — link your Roblox account; your nickname is set to match
> `/continent` — pick your continent so op times can be planned around you
> `/profile` — your full card: Roblox, continent, ops attended, rating, activity

sections.title: 📈  ACTIVITY
sections.body:
> `/activity @member` — messages, ops attended, last seen
> `!inactive [days]` — who's gone quiet (default 14 days)

Activity is tracked passively. No check-ins, no forms — just show up and talk.
